sensor_quality_required_intake_example.why_this_call: Open original measurement or specialist-cited sources, rather than making an assessment from summaries or reference IDs alone. This is batch 1 of 2: 24 of 26 distinct referenced sources, using the application's 24-ID intake batch size (not the gateway maximum). It is not a second discretionary search or a new measurement.
sensor_quality_required_intake_example.why_these_parameters: Inherit the parent task's immutable [60, 120) seconds window (60 seconds); this tool does not choose a new time range. The window end is 120s, not the source clock 125s. Keep the pinned snapshot and version arguments. Select the explicit referenced sources, including pressure summaries for diagnosis and location-fit sources for legacy synthesis where present; not every evidence item in the snapshot. Intake uses batches of at most 24 IDs to bound upfront payloads, grouping large coordinator reads by evidence kind. This is an application batching choice, not the gateway's maximum ID allowance or a diagnostic threshold. Sort only the referenced IDs and take indices [0, 24) of 26. Do not fetch all 227 snapshot evidence items.
